newsitem.title: GERMANY: MG to move metals trade, plans purchase.
newsitem.headline: MG to move metals trade, plans purchase.

text.p: Metallgesellschaft Handel & Beteiligungen AG (MG Handel), the trading subsidiary of Metallgesellschaft AG, said on Wednesday it plans to concentrate its physical metal trading operations in London and New York under the control of MG Metal & Commodity Group.
The operations were previously incorporated in Frankfurt-based MG Metal & Commodity (MG MC) GmbH. The move may entail the relocation of some 56 jobs now based in Frankfurt.
MG also said that as part of the expansion of its trading operations MG Metal & Commodity intends to acquire the copper trading business and certain assets of New York-based Cerro Sales Corporation.
The acquisition is planned for May and the parties have agreed not to disclose the price of the transaction, MG Handel said in a statement.
Cerro Sales is a member of the Marmon Group and is active in the international trading and marketing of non-ferrous, predominantly copper. It has a regional focus in North and South America.

Referring to the planned concentration of physical metals trading in London and New York, MG Handel said the management of MG MC GmbH had started negotiations with employee representatives to work out a social compensation package.
MG Handel spokesman Gerolf Werning said most of its metals trading business was located outside Germany so the move fitted in with company strategy.
Trading in chemical products like sulphur and industrial chemicals would remain located in Frankfurt and Paris, the spokesman said.
